claims.assertion: Mari says a damaged biosphere ship was placed in Earth's orbit after Tiamat's destruction to stabilize it and reflect sunlight; a hologram masks its surface.

claims.assertion: She says lunar antennas alter Earth's magnetosphere and vibration; four of twelve reactors remain active.

claims.qualifiers: Their beams create the Van Allen belts.
